svg.data-power-max-scope: HIG Connecting Power - measured at 40 C ambient, optics fully populated and 100% traffic load; 2545 W is the AC figure and 2279 W the DC one
svg.data-optics-osfp: 800GE OSFP OpenZR+/ZR/2xLR4/2xFR4/DR8+/DR8/SR8 and 400GE OSFP OpenZR+/ZR/ER4/LR4/FR4/SR8/DR4/DR4+/PLR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver list); the HIG port table gives ports 0~63 as 400G/800G up to 2 km
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 1G/10G/25G on the management pair, up to 40 km per the HIG Port Overview table; the datasheet calls the same pair '2 x 10/25G SFP28 ports' and no module list is published for it
svg.data-optic-power-classes: sixteen ports take a 30 W optic and the other forty-eight take 16 W (HIG Figure 9). The 30 W ports are 0, 6, 8, 14, 16, 22, 24, 30, 33, 39, 41, 47, 49, 55, 57 and 63 - the first and fourth cage rows of columns 1, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 13 and 16 counting from the left
svg.data-timing: 1PPS and 10MHz SMB input/output (premium), 50 ohm, cable not to exceed 3 m; Stratum 3E OCXO holdover and ITU-T Synchronous Ethernet (SyncE). The datasheet's compatible cable row names 'SMB coaxial cable with 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz', and the HIG offers a converter where the far end is BNC
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 and micro-USB, both labelled IOIO, 115200 8N1 no flow control; the micro-USB needs a Silicon Labs CP210x driver (HIG Initial System Setup)
svg.data-oob: 1x RJ45 100/1000M plus the 2x SFP28 management pair
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A
svg.data-nebs: NOT A CERTIFICATION - the HIG carries 'Cautions and regulatory compliance statements for NEBS': suitable for installation as part of the Common Bonding Network (CBN); an external Surge Protection Device must be used with AC powered equipment, installed at the AC power service entrance; can be installed in Network Telecommunications Facilities where the National Electric Code applies; the DC input terminals are DC-I (isolated DC return) and the RTN terminal should be isolated from the chassis or rack; the intra-building OOB Ethernet port is suitable for connection to intra-building or unexposed wiring only (Type 2, 4 or 4a per GR-1089). No NEBS level is claimed anywhere in the held documents
svg.data-installation: restricted-access server or computer room only; suitable for Information Technology Rooms per Article 645 of the National Electrical Code and NFPA 75

g.data-description: HIG Connecting the 1PPS Interface - 50 ohm SMB, input/output, cable not to exceed 3 m; a converter cable is offered where the far end is BNC
g.title: tim-1pps

g.data-description: HIG Connecting the 10MHz Interface - 50 ohm SMB, input/output, cable not to exceed 3 m
g.title: tim-10mhz

g.data-description: HIG Initial System Setup - the second console path, labelled IOIO like the RJ45 and reaching the same UART; needs a Silicon Labs CP210x driver
g.title: console-usb

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (timing/clock synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to PTP packet (Phase) or an external timing source (Phase) and frequency locked), Blinking Green (synchronized to PTP packet (Frequency) or an external timing source (Frequency)), Solid Amber (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Amber (synchronization fail or acquiring/holdover time out)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU/BMC boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (fans are not initialized), Solid Green (all FAN modules are working normal), Blinking Amber (FAN fail: one or more FAN modules need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 is working normal), Solid Amber (PSU0 fail, PSU0 needs service). Note the fault state is SOLID amber here where the FAN row blinks - two different rows of the same table
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 is working normal), Solid Amber (PSU1 fail, PSU1 needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, ID row - Off (no power), Solid Blue (reserved), Blinking Blue (beacon feature enabled)
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: HIG Connecting the USB Extender Cable - a maintenance port; the guide gives usbreset and i2cset lines to run after inserting a device
g.title: usb

g.data-description: HIG Initial System Setup - RJ45 console labelled IOIO, 115200 8N1, no flow control. Drawn rotate 180 because this jack shows its latch keyway up and its contacts down, the mirror of the OOB jack below it
g.title: console

g.data-description: HIG Management port LED table - left lamp Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); right lamp Off (no activity), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so they are declared per element
g.title: oob

g.data-description: the stacked SFP28 pair the vendor numbers 64 and 65 - a second out-of-band path, 1G/10G/25G and up to 40 km per the HIG Port Overview table
g.title: port-64

g.data-description: the stacked SFP28 pair the vendor numbers 64 and 65 - a second out-of-band path, 1G/10G/25G and up to 40 km per the HIG Port Overview table
g.title: port-65
